Dates.text: Opportunity lands on the other side of Mars, in Meridiani Planum.
A planet-wide dust storm ends contact with Opportunity.

Title: Spirit and Opportunity
Body-Text: Landing on opposite sides of Mars in January 2004, NASA's twin robotic geologists confirmed that liquid water once existed on the Martian surface. Designed to last just 90 Martian days, both solar-powered rovers far outlived expectations, operating for about 6 and nearly 15 years.
